values.meaning: heal from consuming a chunk, percent of maximum health
duration of resurrection (bloblet split) before Zac is revived

values.binNote: No bin row in the sheet carries this 50% instant heal; ReviveBlobletDuration/HealPercent/TotalHeal only cover the chunk heal and the resurrection duration.

mechanics.claim: While in resurrection Zac is untargetable and unable to act, and cannot take damage except the echoed damage from his bloblets.
mechanics.quote: becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for the duration. ... While in resurrection, '''Zac''' cannot take damage from sources other than the echoed damage from his ''bloblets''.

mechanics.claim: Damage dealt to bloblets (excluding overkill past each bloblet's max health) is echoed to Zac as true damage.
mechanics.quote: Any damage the ''bloblets'' receive, excluding damage dealt in excess of each ''bloblet's'' {{as|'''total maximum''' health}}, is also echoed to '''Zac''' as {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}.

mechanics.claim: After the resurrection duration Zac revives with 10-50% max health depending on his bloblets' total remaining health, and dies if all bloblets are killed first.
mechanics.quote: '''Zac''' is revived with {{as|{{tt|10 – 50%|Based on his bloblets' total remaining health. Reaches the maximum amount at full health on all bloblets}} '''maximum''' health}}. '''Zac''' will be {{tip|execute|executed}} once all bloblets are killed.

mechanics.claim: Zac's abilities have a health cost, and hitting an enemy with an ability sheds chunks that Zac can consume to heal or enemies can destroy.
mechanics.quote: {{cis|Zac}} abilities have a {{as|{{sti|health cost}}}}. Whenever '''Zac's''' abilities damage an enemy, he sheds a number of chunks on the ground

mechanics.claim: Chunks last 6 seconds and Zac must be within 50 units to consume one.
mechanics.quote: he sheds a number of chunks of himself to a nearby location, landing towards nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} and lasting for 6 seconds.
